approvers: Owner/partner, main contractor or developer if specified
reason: We only spend about €1,260 a year on protection, roughly 105 m², so a 150 m² minimum job is more than our whole year. At €19/m² against the €12 we pay now, it makes no sense for a two-person firm.
objection: It costs about 60% more than film and tape, and the minimum job is bigger than our yearly volume. The aluminium usually arrives with factory film anyway.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film, plastic sheet and tape applied by our own labour.
would_change_my_mind: A price at or below what film costs us all-in, with no minimum job size, and a client who specifies it in the tender.
